content: विवेकः .²1 Discrimination, judgment, discernment, discretion; काश्यपि यातस्तवापि च विवेकः <ls>Bv. 1. 68</ls>, <ls n="Bv. 1.">66</ls>; ज्ञातोऽयं जलधर तावको विवेकः <ls n="Bv. 1.">96</ls>; विवेकभ्रष्टानां भवति विनिपातः शतमुखः <ls>Bh. 2. 10</ls>. .²2 Consideration, discussion, investigation; यच्छृङ्गारविवेकतत्त्वमपि यत् काव्येषु लीलायितम् <ls>Gīt. 12</ls>; so द्वैत˚, धर्म˚. .²3 Distinction, difference, discriminating (between two things); नीरक्षीरविवेके हंसालस्यं त्वमेव तनुषे चेत् <ls>Bv. 1. 13</ls>; एकतामिव गतस्य विवेकः कस्यचिन्न महतोऽप्युपलेभे <ls>Ki. 9. 12</ls>; <ls>Bk. 17. 60</ls>. .²4 (In Vedānta <ab>phil.</ab>) The power of distinguishing between the visible world and the invisible spirit, or of separating reality from mere semblance or illusion. .²5 True knowledge. .²6 A receptacle for water, basin, reservoir.
